propositions: Tracked files with local working-tree changes (deletions or modifications) cause git merge origin/tickets to abort with 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge', stranding reconverge unable to advance and orphaning local ticket commits

The recovery mechanism detects this abort signature, parses the named file paths, and for each path checks its status: DELETIONS are restored from HEAD via git checkout, MODIFICATIONS are copied byte-for-byte to a quarantine directory before being restored from HEAD
After restoring or quarantining+restoring all named paths, the merge is retried once; if it succeeds, both parents are preserved and the local commit remains reachable
Genuine merge conflicts (both sides commit different content) still abort, keep local, and hint fsck-recover without invoking the recovery logic
The implementation reuses the proven recovery seam and parser structure from variant (a) (untracked files), extending one reviewed mechanism rather than adding a second
